sloka: तम् दृष्ट्वा परम प्रीतो विश्वामित्रो महाबलः ।प्रणतो विनयात् वीरो वसिष्ठम् जपताम् वरम् ॥१-५२-१॥
transliteration: tam dṛṣṭvā parama prīto viśvāmitro mahābalaḥ ।praṇato vinayāt vīro vasiṣṭham japatām varam ॥1-52-1॥

translations.english: Overwhelmed with joy the mighty, heroic Viswamitra upon seeing Vasishta, the greatest among ascetics, was and offered respectful salutations.
